resources.name: SCEP SPEC-013 Simulator Bootstrap
resources.description: Prepare one isolated SPEC-013 SimulationRun and its external simulator inputs. Run folder 1 first, save the RUNNING bootstrap response and copy scenario_json plus simulator_env from the Base Environment. Execute the external simulator, then run folder 2 to verify public resources and complete the run.

resources.name: SPEC-013 1 - Prepare External Simulator
resources.description: Run requests 01 through 12 in order. Request 10 starts the run and captures the one-time token. Request 11 is the RUNNING bootstrap that must be saved as the configured bootstrap path. Do not run the post-simulator folder yet.

resources.name: SPEC-013 2 - Verify and Complete After Simulator
resources.description: Run only after uv run python -m app.main finishes with a FINISHED report. Requests verify the still-RUNNING backend run, generated Reservation, completed Charging Session and Telemetry before the administrator completes the SimulationRun.

resources.name: 01 - Login Bootstrap Administrator and Initialize
resources.afterResponseScript:
insomnia.test('administrator login returns 200', () => insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code, '401: update admin_email/admin_password to the persisted local administrator credentials').to.eql(200));
if (insomnia.response.code === 200) insomnia.baseEnvironment.set('admin_token', insomnia.response.json().access_token);

resources.name: 02 - Create Dedicated UTC Facility

body.text:

resources.name: 03 - Create Station and Connector
04 - Create Dedicated EVDriver
06 - Create EVDriver Vehicle
07 - Create DRAFT SimulationRun
08 - Inspect DRAFT SimulationRun
resources.afterResponseScript:
const body = insomnia.response.json();
insomnia.test('prepared run remains DRAFT with no accepted logical time', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); insomnia.expect(body.status).to.eql('DRAFT'); insomnia.expect(body.last_accepted_simulated_at).to.eql(null); });

resources.name: 09 - Export DRAFT Bootstrap for Inspection
10 - START Run and Build Simulator Environment
11 - Export RUNNING Bootstrap - Save This Response
12 - Verify Run Ready for External Simulator
resources.afterResponseScript:
const body = insomnia.response.json();
insomnia.test('run is ready and simulator values were captured', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); insomnia.expect(body.status).to.eql('RUNNING'); insomnia.expect(body.last_accepted_simulated_at).to.eql(null); insomnia.expect(insomnia.baseEnvironment.get('simulation_run_token').length).to.be.greaterThan(20); insomnia.expect(insomnia.baseEnvironment.get('driver_token').length).to.be.greaterThan(20); insomnia.expect(insomnia.baseEnvironment.get('scenario_json')).to.include('spec-013-insomnia-smoke'); insomnia.expect(insomnia.baseEnvironment.get('bootstrap_json')).to.include('RUNNING'); insomnia.expect(insomnia.baseEnvironment.get('simulator_env')).to.include('SIMULATION_RUN_TOKEN='); insomnia.expect(insomnia.baseEnvironment.get('SIMULATION_RUN_TOKEN').length).to.be.greaterThan(20); insomnia.expect(insomnia.baseEnvironment.get('SIMULATION_DRIVER_TOKENS_JSON')).to.include(insomnia.baseEnvironment.get('driver_id')); });

resources.name: 13 - Verify Simulator Finished While Run Remains RUNNING
resources.afterResponseScript:
const body = insomnia.response.json();
insomnia.test('external simulator advanced logical time without completing backend run', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); insomnia.expect(body.status).to.eql('RUNNING'); insomnia.expect(body.last_accepted_simulated_at).to.be.a('string'); });

resources.name: 14 - Verify Simulated Reservation
15 - Verify Completed Charging Session
16 - Verify Simulator Telemetry
resources.afterResponseScript:
const body = insomnia.response.json();
insomnia.test('simulated Session exposes Telemetry samples', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); insomnia.expect(body.length).to.be.greaterThan(0); insomnia.expect(body.every(item => item.source === 'SIMULATOR')).to.eql(true); });

resources.name: 17 - COMPLETE SimulationRun as Administrator
resources.afterResponseScript:
const body = insomnia.response.json();
insomnia.test('administrator completes the SimulationRun', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); insomnia.expect(body.status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); insomnia.expect(body.completed_at).to.be.a('string'); });
